representation: Reports, prompts and receipts are byte-exact. Complete delivered sources are in losslessly gzipped chains. Raw execution payloads remain local; audit summaries are explicit bounded derivatives.
independence: Independent initials share the frozen source packet. Confirmations use the original reviewer, its own report, the actual runtime delta and explicitly selected author responses and source evidence, except where reviewerOrigin is fresh-context-replacement: that same-family reviewer received the original reviewer's attributed reports after proven context exhaustion, and is never identified as the original. Void, unlaunched and incomplete attempts are preserved under superseded/ and never accepted. Intermediate confirmations retain their raw verdicts and snapshot-specific acceptance; neither accepted nor unaccepted earlier snapshots are final acceptance of this revision.
limits: Bounded textual and host evidence, not native/device or arbitrary-pool acceptance.
